fire: It was really embarrassing when my phone rang during the quiet exam.
The team suffered an embarrassing defeat against the last-placed club.
My dad told an embarrassing story about me in front of all my friends.
The minister made an embarrassing mistake during the live interview.
It is a little embarrassing to admit that I still sleep with a night light.
She tripped on stage in a deeply embarrassing moment at the ceremony.
The leaked emails were embarrassing for the company's whole board.
Forgetting his name twice in one evening was rather embarrassing.
